topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 47 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 5 ERC4626 vaults, 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 25 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, erc20permit). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
